body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> LG Electronics(www.lge.co.kr) will unveil the world's slimmest LED LCD TV 'LH95' at the upcoming CES 2009 held in Las Vegas.

Featuring 24.8mm thickness, the LH95 supports 240Hz TrueMotion Drive technology and 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio. According to the company, this LED LCD TV is 2009 CES Innovation Award winners in the Display category.
